question: Which of our systems should we fix first, and what do we know about each?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS system, s.business_criticality AS tier, s.environment, s.data_class, s.internet_facing, COALESCE(d.dependents, 0) AS dependents, s.end_of_support, COALESCE(p.open_patches, 0) AS open_patches, COALESCE(p.known_exploited_open, 0) AS known_exploited_open, p.max_epss_open, p.max_cvss_open, COALESCE(c.untested_changes, 0) AS untested_changes, r.days_since_test, r.result AS recovery_result, COALESCE(k.credentials_wide, 0) AS credentials_wide, CASE WHEN t.technology IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_scenario, s.loss_event FROM pg.estate.systems s LEFT JOIN (SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS dependents FROM pg.estate.dependencies GROUP BY system_id) d ON d.system_id = s.system_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS open_patches, SUM(CASE WHEN known_exploited THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS known_exploited_open, MAX(epss) AS max_epss_open, MAX(cvss_score) AS max_cvss_open FROM pg.estate.patches WHERE applied_on IS NULL GROUP BY system_id) p ON p.system_id = s.system_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS untested_changes FROM pg.estate.changes WHERE preprod_tested = FALSE GROUP BY system_id) c ON c.system_id = s.system_id LEFT JOIN pg.estate.recovery_tests r ON r.system_id = s.system_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS credentials_wide FROM (SELECT system_id FROM pg.estate.sharepoint_items WHERE kind = 'credential' AND shared_with IN ('department','company','external','anyone') UNION ALL SELECT system_id FROM pg.estate.slack_messages WHERE kind = 'credential' AND channel_kind IN ('public','external')) w WHERE system_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY system_id) k ON k.system_id = s.system_id LEFT JOIN pg.estate.scenario_technology t ON t.technology = s.technology AND t.case_id = 'nov-2026-cluster' ORDER BY s.business_criticality, s.system_id
